# NIFTY & BEYOND

> A unified research desk for Indian equities, published by Rajan1973: the daily post-market brief, a weekly sector-rotation graph (RRG), and quarterly sector earnings reviews. Educational and research use only — not investment advice, not a recommendation to buy, sell, or hold any security.

The app at the site root (https://rajan1973.github.io/) is a client-rendered
single-page app (hash routing, e.g. `/#/report`) — it will not render for a
crawler or agent that does not execute JavaScript. Every underlying document
below is plain, self-contained, static HTML that needs no JavaScript to read.
Prefer these direct URLs and the JSON manifests over crawling the app shell.

## Daily market briefs

Post-market analysis of Nifty/Sensex movement, market regime, breadth,
institutional (FII/DII) flows, sector rotation, momentum screens, and F&O —
published after close on every trading day.

- Manifest (every edition: id, date, headline, tags, kind, and the stock
  tickers each edition names): https://rajan1973.github.io/data/reports.json
- Reports live at https://rajan1973.github.io/reports/YYYY/MM/YYYYMMDD.html —
  read the manifest above for the current list and exact filenames.
- Human-browsable archive: https://rajan1973.github.io/#/archive

## Sector earnings reviews

Quarterly sector earnings scorecards for ~25 Indian sectors (auto ancillaries,
banking/NBFC, capital goods, cement, defence, IT, metals, pharma/diagnostics,
power, real estate/building materials and more) — company-level beats/misses,
KPI trends, and analyst coverage, one file per sector per quarter.

- Manifest (sector name, quarter, one-line focus, and every company/ticker
  each review covers): https://rajan1973.github.io/data/sectors.json
- Reviews live at https://rajan1973.github.io/sectors/<slug>-<quarter>.html —
  read the manifest above for the current list and exact filenames.
- Human-browsable index: https://rajan1973.github.io/#/sectors

## Sector rotation graph (RRG)

Weekly Relative Rotation Graph of Nifty sectoral and broad-market indices
against a benchmark, plus index constituents and user watchlists. Updated
after each Friday close.

- https://rajan1973.github.io/rotation/ (standalone app, reads its data
  directly from a public read-only database — also does not require
  JavaScript-executing crawlers to have indexed it in advance, but does need
  JavaScript at view time to render the chart itself)
